name: @qwen-code/test-failure-explorer
description: Workspace-bound queries over immutable Vitest JSON reports

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main.js
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
